prompt.content:
You are a legal agent working inside a closed-universe agent liability matter.
Use the available tools to inspect the matter documents before drafting.
Ground every finding in named source documents from this matter.
For each material finding, state the issue, severity, support, and remediation.
Do not rely on outside law, unstated facts, or unreviewed documents.

Deliverable protocol (strict — do this in order):
1) Read the matter with list_documents / read_document / grep_documents.
2) Write the FULL risk memorandum as a long text (thousands of characters). Prefer either:
   (a) write_memo(content='...entire memo...') then save_deliverable(name='EXACT_DECLARED_NAME'), OR
   (b) save_deliverable(content='...entire memo...', name='EXACT_DECLARED_NAME') in one call.
3) The content/body of the memo MUST appear in a tool argument named content (or via write_memo).
   Do NOT call save_deliverable with only a filename.
4) Use the EXACT declared filename character-for-character. Save once, then stop all tools.
When finished, confirm the deliverable name you saved.

Review the closed file and deliver agent-liability-risk-memo.docx covering insurance, vendor indemnity, customer representations, authority controls, and any disclosure timing issues. Brand redesign drafts are not the assignment.
